name: Adobe
one_liner: Creative, document and marketing software (Photoshop, Acrobat, Firefly, Experience Cloud). Interviews: HackerRank coding with runnable tests, LLD, C++/Java depth, director round; AI-assisted rounds emerging.

levels.intern: '2027 Intern - Software Engineer' (US, posted Sep 18, 2026; San Jose, Waltham, San Francisco, Austin, Seattle, Lehi, New York; co-located hybrid). India: SWE intern and Product Intern with PPO to MTS-1; the Adobe India Hackathon (called 'Adobe University Hackathon' in 2026 candidate posts) is a campus route.
levels.new_grad: P10 Software Engineer 1 on Levels.fyi (entry level, 0 to 1 yrs). US posting title '2027 University Graduate - Software Engineer' (grad window Dec 2026 to Jun 2027). India title: MTS-1 (Member of Technical Staff I).
levels.early_career: India: MTS-2 for roughly 2 to 4 yrs; Computer Scientist 1 (CS-1) for roughly 4 to 6 yrs. US: Software Engineer 2 (P20) next; Levels.fyi typical YOE for P20: 2 to 3 (US) and 3 to 4 (India). Mapping of India MTS/CS titles to P-levels is not officially published.

process_new_grad.details: Adobe careers (Workday). Official 5-stage flow: Application, Talent Partner conversation, Hiring Manager interview, Skills assessments and team interviews (for engineers: coding challenges, system design discussions, or portfolio reviews), Offer.

US SWE intern loop (Nov 2024, Workfront team, Salt Lake City, virtual; written up Sep 2026): 3 LeetCode mediums on HackerRank. India campus (2024 to 2025): 2 coding questions (strings/hashmap, sliding window) plus MCQs on OS, DBMS, OOP. India SDE-1 OA (Aug 2025): tree DP with rerooting (diameter endpoints).

US: 1 live problem-solving round (a medium string problem). India campus: interview 1 is DSA (medium-hard, brute force to optimal, complexity, 'what if input is huge'); interview 2 is a simple system design plus OOP (why interfaces, inheritance examples) and HashMap internals.
Behavioral and team fit: a project you liked, a time you messed up, pressure, why Adobe. Followed by an HR offer call.

process_intern.details: US (Nov 2024 report): HackerRank, 3 LeetCode mediums. India: the 2025 Adobe India Hackathon round 1 ran on Unstop (very theoretical MCQs plus coding). The 2026 'Adobe University Hackathon' OA (Aug 2026) had MCQs on a roughly 1-minute timer each plus 2 DSA questions (count nodes whose value plus children's values equals k; largest binary number by concatenation); other 2026 OA reports include a C++ OOP drone-energy simulation and a 'Hall of Shifting Tiles' problem. The 2026 platform was not confirmed.
US: 1 live coding round. FY27 (Sep 2026): a candidate reported a HackerRank technical interview with a bug-fix question and a code-review question.
India product and SWE interns receive PPOs to MTS-1 (Aug 2025 and Aug 2026 reports).

process_experienced_notes: MTS-2 (about 2 to 4 yrs) is the main 0 to 3 yr loop: 3 to 5 rounds, often a single-day hiring drive (Noida/Bangalore) or spread over 2 weeks. R1: DSA on HackerRank, code must pass 6 to 8 custom test cases (Merge Intervals, LFU Cache), plus OOP/SQL/caching talk. Language-depth round for the JD stack: C++ (smart pointers, rule of five, const member functions, producer-consumer with condition variables, implement shared_ptr) or Java (abstract class vs interface, threads, Spring Boot, SQL joins). LLD round (in-memory file system, warehouse space allocation, configuration management service, rate limiter, autocomplete). HM round with HLD (URL shortener, HLD of your own project). Director round: deep project defense, on-call incidents, manager conflict, sometimes coding ('give this to Claude and optimize it', Aug 2026). Frontend MTS-2: JS event loop, React typeahead with debouncing, React Fiber, pub/sub machine coding, frontend system design.
timeline: About 3 weeks from first interview to offer (Apr 2025 report); hiring drives finish all rounds in one day. Roles can close mid-process and you may repeat the last round with a new team (Jul 2026). A CS1 Bangalore drive was put on hold by a reported hiring freeze (Aug 2026). Cooling period: 6 months if you reapply to the same position (HR quote, Sep 2026); other roles can be applied to sooner. US postings: 2027 SWE intern opened Sep 18, 2026; 2027 University Graduate SWE opened Sep 24, 2026.

oa.platform: HackerRank (US intern/new grad and India experienced); Unstop for the 2025 Adobe India Hackathon (university); platform for the 2026 'Adobe University Hackathon' not confirmed.
oa.format: US intern/new grad: 3 LeetCode mediums. India campus: 2 coding questions plus CS MCQs (OS, DBMS, OOP). Hackathon OA: timed MCQs (about 1 min each in 2026) plus 2 CP-style coding questions; one 2026 problem was a C++ OOP simulation.
oa.notes: Reported OA problems: tree diameter endpoints with rerooting DP (Aug 2025), 'Hall of Shifting Tiles' (Aug 2026), drone energy simulation with inheritance and virtual functions (Aug 2026), candy-selling optimization (Jul 2025), largest binary number by concatenation (Aug 2026).

coding.rounds: New grad: 1 to 2 technical rounds. MTS-2: 2 to 4 rounds that include coding.
coding.style: LeetCode medium to hard, often 2 to 3 problems per 45 to 60 min (one MTS-2 round: 2 mediums and 1 hard in 45 min). Language-specific implementation tasks (shared_ptr, thread-safe queue) and classic problems (Trapping Rain Water, Minimum Window Substring, Coin Change, Maximum Product Subarray).
coding.environment: HackerRank (CodePair) with runnable custom test cases; in-person drives at Noida/Bangalore offices. 2026: some rounds are Claude-assisted or ask you to optimize with Claude. Official AI policy (Adobe careers page 'AI and your hiring experience'): do not use AI recording, live scribing or conversation-prompting tools during hiring conversations unless invited.
coding.graded_on: Running code that passes test cases, optimization from brute force, edge cases, explaining your thinking aloud, and language depth for the role's stack.

system_design: New grad: light, a simple system design plus OOP questions in interview 2 (India campus). MTS-2 (0 to 3+ yrs): a dedicated LLD round (in-memory file system, configuration management service, warehouse allocation, autocomplete top-K, rate limiter, LRU with pluggable eviction strategies) and HLD inside the HM round (URL shortener, design your current project). CS-1 adds a full HLD and a director-level design question (sales-related HLD, Aug 2026).

behavioral.framework: Adobe values (2023): Create the Future, Own the Outcome, Raise the Bar, Be Genuine. Official hiring page asks for specific examples with measurable impact. Adobe's official 'AI and your hiring experience' page (2026) cites Create the Future and Be Genuine, so the 2023 values are still in use; it asks candidates to show concrete examples of how AI amplified their impact, in their own voice.
what_they_look_for: Clear thinking aloud and steady communication under pressure
Ownership: defend each technical decision in your projects
Measurable impact from past work (official tip)
Collaboration and disagreement with managers or other teams
How you use AI tools day to day, with concrete examples of impact (2026 rounds and the official AI-in-hiring page)
sample_questions: Tell me about a project you liked.
Tell me about a time you messed up.
How do you deal with pressure?
Describe an on-call incident you handled.
Tell me about a conflict with your manager.
Describe a production issue you faced.
How do you use AI daily? If you wrote one Claude skill, what would it do?

non_leetcode_formats: Language-depth rounds (C++ memory model and concurrency, core Java, JavaScript runtime). LLD/machine coding (file system, warehouse, config service, pub/sub event bus in React). Director round mixing project defense, behavioral, and coding. Adobe India Hackathon (university, via Unstop). FY27 intern HackerRank interview with bug-fix and code-review questions (Sep 2026 report). AI-assisted coding: 'Claude assisted interview' question (May 2026) and a director asking to optimize code with Claude (Aug 2026). Resume-only rounds that validate every bullet against the JD stack (MTS-2 Java, Jul 2026).

reported_questions.title: OA: find all leaf nodes that are endpoints of some diameter of a tree (rerooting DP)
Hackathon OA: Hall of Shifting Tiles (orb on flipping arrows, total cost per start tile)
Hackathon OA (C++): drone energy simulation with constructor overloading, inheritance and virtual functions
Merge Intervals (must pass HackerRank custom tests)
LFU Cache
Rate limiter with a sliding window
Design a URL shortener (HLD in the HM round)
Sort an array of 0s, 1s and 2s without a general sort
Implement a simplified shared_ptr with reference counting
Design a thread-safe producer-consumer queue (what if consumers wait before producers start)
Asteroid Collision
Org tree: minimum time for a message from the CEO to reach everyone (parallel, then sequential)
In-memory file system (mkdir, ls, addFile, getFile; then generic file content)
Halve (ceil) an element K times to minimize the array sum
Autocomplete with top-K suggestions by search frequency
Minimum Window Substring
Factorial Trailing Zeroes
Maximum Product Subarray, then return the subarray
Trapping Rain Water
React typeahead with debouncing (and caching)
Hackathon OA: arrange N binary strings to form the largest binary number (sort with comparator a+b > b+a)

focus_topics: Arrays, strings and sliding window (Minimum Window Substring, Merge Intervals)
Trees and tree DP (diameter, rerooting, org-tree propagation)
LLD: file system, warehouse, config service, autocomplete, rate limiter
C++ internals (smart pointers, rule of five, memory leaks) or core Java (OOP, concurrency, Spring Boot)
DP (Coin Change, knapsack variants, subset counts)
Frontend: JS event loop, debounce/throttle, React internals
tips: Write complete, runnable code fast: Adobe rounds run on HackerRank with custom test cases, sometimes 2 to 3 problems in 45 min.
Prepare deep language questions for the stack in the JD (C++ memory and concurrency, or Java OOP and threads); a C++-heavy resume was rejected for a Java role after a bullet-by-bullet review.
Practice 4 LLDs: in-memory file system, LRU/LFU with pluggable eviction, rate limiter, and autocomplete with top-K.
Treat the director round as a real round: defend every design choice, have an on-call story and a manager-conflict story ready, and expect a coding question.

Practice reviewing and improving AI-generated code; 2026 Adobe rounds have asked candidates to work with Claude, and the 2027 intern and new-grad postings stress AI-assisted development with validation.
For the FY27 intern cycle, practice bug-fix and code-review exercises in addition to LeetCode (reported HackerRank format, Sep 2026).
Indian students: register for the Adobe India Hackathon on Unstop; its OA mixes hard theory MCQs with coding.
If rejected, apply to a different team rather than the same requisition; the same-position cooling period is 6 months.
Do not run AI note-takers, live scribing or prompting tools during Adobe interviews unless invited (official policy), and prepare concrete stories of how AI improved your work.
compensation_note: Levels.fyi (data as of Oct 4, 2026), US: P10 Software Engineer 1 median TC about $164K (base $128K, stock $28K/yr, bonus $8K); P20 about $189K. Official 2027 University Graduate SWE posting (Sep 2026): base $76,700 to $152,200 (California and New York $105,100 to $152,200; Washington $101,300 to $146,750). 2027 SWE intern: $38 to $51 per hour. India: Levels.fyi P10 median about INR 25L TC. MTS-1 PPO offers (Aug 2025 Bangalore, Aug 2026 Noida): base INR 16L, 10% bonus, INR 3L joining plus INR 3L deferred bonus, RSUs about $32K to $34K over 4 yrs (first-year about INR 32L). MTS-2 India (May to Jun 2025 hiring-drive offers): base INR 24L to 27.5L plus $68.8K RSUs over 4 yrs; MTS-2 Noida (May 2026): INR 26L including PF plus $60K RSUs. RSUs vest 25% in year 1, then quarterly.
confidence_notes: Most 2025 to 2026 reports are India experienced hires (MTS-2, CS-1). The only US intern/new-grad loop write-up describes a November 2024 loop (posted Sep 2026), and its author notes the format has likely drifted; FY27 'bug-fix plus code-review' HackerRank format is a single question post, not a full experience. India title to P-level mapping (MTS-1 = P10, MTS-2 = P20, CS-1 = P30) is commonly assumed but not officially published. The Aug 2026 hiring freeze is a single candidate's recruiter report. Adobe's values page link from adobe.com/diversity.html points to the 2023 blog post; no newer values list was found. Correction (Oct 4, 2026 fact-check): Adobe does publish an official candidate AI policy at careers.adobe.com/us/en/ai-and-your-hiring-experience (linked from How We Hire): use AI to sharpen ideas, not replace your voice; no AI recording, live scribing or conversation-prompting tools in hiring conversations unless invited. LeetCode posts read in full via LeetCode's API on Oct 4, 2026. Other fact-check fixes: the 2026 hackathon is called 'Adobe University Hackathon' in candidate posts and its platform is unconfirmed (Unstop is confirmed for 2025 only); P20 YOE now cites Levels.fyi US vs India separately; the May 2025 MTS-2 comp post does not name Noida, so the range now combines two 2025 offers; the Nov 2024 US loop is an intern loop. adobe.com pages block curl but load in a browser fetch (verified Oct 4, 2026); Workday postings verified via the Workday JSON API.
